title: Apollo 11 Moon landing
summary: On 20 July 1969 the lunar module Eagle landed in the Sea of Tranquility at 4:18 p.m. EDT, carrying Neil Armstrong and Edwin Aldrin, while Michael Collins piloted the command module. Armstrong became the first person to walk on the Moon, and Aldrin joined him about 20 minutes later. The mission fulfilled President Kennedy's 1961 goal of a crewed lunar landing and return.

uncertainty.note: Landing 20 July 1969, 4:18 p.m. EDT. The mission ran 16-24 July 1969.
